title: Persistent Computational Workspace — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Preserves project state, intermediate results, dependencies, and recovery points across sessions. A proposed workspace that never forgets: project state, intermediate results, exact dependency versions, and recovery points persist across sessions, crashes, and machines. A researcher can close a laptop in March, open it in September, and resume exactly — with the full history of how each result was produced.
capabilities: Persist project state across sessions and machines
Keep intermediate results with their provenance
Pin exact dependency versions per snapshot
Create and restore recovery points
Show the full history of how any result was produced
